# Original piston model source and rights evidence

Source-only proposal reviewed 2026-10-04. Package `original-piston-prop-v1`, version `0.1.0-prototype`, backend model `original-piston-prop`; status original engineering prototype, unvalidated, with no backend trial. [ADR010](../../../docs/decisions/010-original-piston-profile.md) requires a checked exact source/reference package before runtime consumers. This evidence does not close C172S engine/electrical issues or a phase gate.

The [inventory](../../../native/fdm_jsbsim/models/original-piston-prop/inventory.json) SHA256 **f7766fda173d8ee83d4c4a8c02f6333124175a1f7064d3f4d8e78df3d17da12a** binds three original XML files and the source README/parameter ledger/full MIT notice. The [ledger](../../../native/fdm_jsbsim/models/original-piston-prop/parameter-ledger.json) SHA256 **eb471b5590351bee000c346acfa091a2c84ae526540794afe0e23833ca02106c** enumerates every engine/prop scalar and unit, authored numerical tables, effective pinned defaults/conversions, installation and limits. This grant covers the original model source only; JSBSim library code remains separately registered and governed by its component/source-delivery obligations.

## Original source and attribution

Engine/propeller XML and four piecewise tables were authored from project engineering choices, without copying vendor aircraft/engine XML, manufacturer manuals, calibration data, third-party aircraft art or real-airport data. Backend tag/property identifiers are API syntax, not manufacturer aircraft data. One piston/direct ratio 1/fixed-pitch two-blade propeller 6 ft in diameter installation has explicit original inputs; its MaxHP/RPM parameters are not certified limits. Positive CP is deliberately dissipative and is not realistic aerodynamic windmilling or freestream self-start. Thermal/oil computation remains internal unqualified substrate.

Five airframe XML subtrees - metrics, mass balance, original tricycle gear, pass-through controls and polynomial aerodynamics - are unchanged from the project-MIT [original-interactive airframe](../../../native/fdm_jsbsim/models/original-interactive/aircraft/original-interactive/original-interactive.xml), SHA256 0213ab8c1176e5d20b01f980da9cb94913f3e9ad8866838adc7e77bf3130722a. The inventory/ledger preserves its source and historical flight/cart lineage. Existing legacy XML/inventories and parameter choices remain unchanged. The new engine/prop/tank installation is separately original. Airframe format 2.0 and propeller sign convention 1.1 are not package versions or fidelity evidence.

## Bounded source checks and remaining gates

Source checks parse XML without JSBSim, verify exact file/hash/size/LF closure, metadata/scalar units, four table rows/strict keys, one-engine/tank/feed topology, direct ratio 1/fixed-pitch mode and legacy subtree inheritance. Negative cases include rehashed incorrect inertia units, rehashed changed drive ratio/gear/table keys/external aliases, unexpected files, invalid identity and false runtime claims. These checks establish source consistency only. Independent equations/references must freeze before model loading/traces; numerical budgets are not derived from observed output.

An original private candidate remains retained unchanged with inventory b96ec21a5d541293a3836f8838dba8de2e96116eda61ad6213d55675fe8bce77 and ledger b5273ff6d867590ba8f791ed2024713a6cec8d7485a18d2be8fc3fae6f18676a. This publishable metadata revision changes status/README/inventory bindings and explicitly corrects one thermal-note encoding to ASCII temperature=-9999; all XML and numerical ledger fields are exact. The original private candidate and prior publication revision remain preserved. The proposed rights-register Main URL is a future locator, not a claim that this source is already published. Runtime/profile consumers, native source fingerprint, portable/exported behavior, DLL/source replacement, device compatibility, engine lifecycle/physics acceptance and pilot evaluation are later gates. No new runtime pin header, library build or simulator executable is supplied by this leaf.

Loader correction for issue127: the first bounded trial failed before any coupled tick. Omit only the unsupported explicit DEG K/DEGK oil-temperature unit attribute; implicit FGPiston Kelvin scalar350 and all other authored numeric choices are unchanged. Historical v2 and original source are preserved. Runtime acceptance is still separate.
